info.name: DecksmithOS Auto DJ
info.author: DecksmithOS
info.description: Auto DJ transitions (blend, filter, echo, reverb, cut, loop roll, riser, brake) chosen per pair of tracks and aligned to phrases, and the on-screen buttons of the DecksmithOS Standalone skin that need a script (navigation, X-PAD, RELEASE FX). Runs on a virtual MIDI device; has no controls.
